slides.texte_overlay:
ADHD things
that look rude
(but aren't)

1. interrupting mid-sentence

not because what you're saying
doesn't matter. the thought
will be gone in 3 seconds
if it doesn't come out

2. not looking at you
while you talk

looking away helps them
focus on your words
instead of your face

3. forgetting your birthday

it doesn't mean you're forgotten.
dates slip through the cracks,
people don't

4. finishing your sentences

they're not rushing you.
they're excited they know
where you're going

5. going quiet in a group

sometimes the noise is too much
and their brain just
needs to step back

6. leaving without saying bye

the social battery hit zero
and slipping out was
the only way to hide it
